# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.1

Version 1.4.1 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.0

- **Joining a PC's room from another network.**
  - **The problem:** a PC host asks its home router to open the room's port (UPnP), and the room code carries that
    port. If the router does not really pass that port on, or Windows' firewall keeps it closed, a guest using the
    code never reached the room. Meanwhile the room was already finding the guest through the DHT and opening a way
    from its own side, but the guest ignored where those packets came from.
  - **The fix:** a guest joining by code now joins where the room's packets come from.
- **Windows: packets no longer held back.** When a packet goes to a computer that is gone (common while searching the
  DHT), Windows reports it as an error on the next packet received. That error used to stop the game reading packets
  for the rest of the frame. It is now turned off, and packets after it are still read.
- **The train and the part-time job.** As in the original game, the station master runs no train for a character
  who has not finished Tom Nook's part-time job ("no train will come for a while"). A guest whose character is still
  on the job is now told so when the host's town is ready.
- README:
  - guests must have finished the part-time job;
  - on Windows, allow the game for public networks too (Windows often counts a home connection as public).
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

What v1.4.0 brought (tools in other players' hands, the rooms' state and more of the town in multiplayer) is in the
[v1.4.0 release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.0).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.0's, so v1.4.0 and v1.4.1 can be in the same room. A guest still
  needs v1.4.1 for the joining fix.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.1-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.1-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.1-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.1-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- New multiplayer unit test, against a fake DHT node: the room's code carries a forwarded port that does not reach
  the room, and a guest with that code still gets in, where the room's packets come from. Without the fix this test
  fails.
- All unit tests pass. The Windows socket code builds for 32 and 64 bits.
- No change to the decomp.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.1, versionCode 10401).

## Known limitations

- Joining between two real, different networks has still not been tried much. If a room on a PC still cannot be
  joined:
  - check that the game is allowed through Windows' firewall for both private and public networks;
  - turn off any VPN program;
  - open an [issue](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/issues) with the "Internet address" line from the
    multiplayer page.
- The limitations of v1.4.0 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.0)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
